source_scope: All currently imported project Python files plus the named test, freezer, reviewed native semantics, public scorer/search and project configuration. These native files are read-only source references, not a compiled-runtime acceptance.

source_semantics.finding: Source occupancy ends and target occupancy begins at irreversible reservation publication through edge_to; arrival time alone is insufficient. Per-tray OR counting includes station, incoming edge and reception reservation.
Observed entry receipt follows reservation and emits the resource-waiter notification. The named .001 wake bound belongs only to the isolated known source-path timing.

A resource wake after the same node has already arbitrated at this timestamp adds max(minimum_service_seconds,dispatch_headway_seconds). The public fixture uses.001; the analytic bound assumes only the one identified wake, not arbitrary downstream wakes.
Native Storage logic is already per job. The old public predictor has only loaded-specific Storage handling and cannot predict this new P stage unchanged.
A preference is neither forced edge nor forced waiting. All new edges are ordinary alternatives for every eligible tray; S4 and current capacity must determine the actual edge.
